messages:
maria: quick check — I see a small spike in 502s around 14:02 UTC on prod. suspect kvcache timeouts after the prefix-cache tweak. where's the fastest dash + traces to grab a couple of samples? also want a quick opinion on alert debounce/window and runbook pointer.
sam: dash path: Observability > Ingress > Errors -> 5xx heatmap. direct link (ops): https://app.redwood/observability/dash/ingress-5xx. For traces use Trace Explorer filter: service:gateway AND http.status_code:502, range:15m. quick logs query: `level:error AND http.status_code:502 AND message:timeout`
lee: if kvcache related, check node logs for "kvcache-miss" and look for `prefix_cache` spans in traces. in tracing UI search `operation:prefix.fetch AND error:true` — that usually surfaces the failing backend call.
kai: FYI alert rule is `ingress-5xx-rate-prod`. current eval: 2m window, threshold 1.5%. for short bursts I'd bump window to 5m and threshold to 2% or add a 3-occurrence debounce over 10m. also exclude /healthz and internal-bot user agents.
infra-bot: Alert triggered: ingress-5xx-rate-prod (severity: page) at 2026-03-17T14:03:05Z — firing window: 2m. Incident: #INC-4721. See https://app.redwood/incidents/4721
maria: :thumbsup: I'll pull 3 trace ids and paste them into the incident. planning to open a PR to change eval to 5m and add the /healthz exclusion. will tag oncall if pages continue.
sam: quick helper — run this in logs service to get trace ids: `index=prod gateway | where status=502 | sort _time desc | head 20 | fields trace_id` then paste into the ticket.
lee: runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/502-gateway-timeouts — see section "kvcache timeout hunt" steps 2-5 for the checklist.
maria: plan: change alert -> 5m / 2% with 3-occurrence debounce, monitor for 24h, escalate if sustained. attaching traces now.
kai: sgtm. please add a short blurb in the PR describing observed pattern (burst vs sustained) and whether canary traffic shows same effect. tag infra-sre for visibility.
maria: done — PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/628 (wip). attached 3 trace ids and example log lines in the incident. will update after alert change lands.
sam: thanks. if you want me to push the alert change I can do a quick canary apply between 14:30-14:35.
maria: appreciate it, let's wait until we've got the 3 traces validated. will ping here when ready. :white_check_mark:
